resolved_finding.issue: The retired flag can precede live InputDiscard cleanup in gRPC undispatched-reset or late-body cleanup paths.
resolved_finding.correction: Require request.retired with Acquire and request.live_ops == 0 with Acquire after acceptor join; no host-wide or budget join.

limitations: Source review does not establish runtime success or performance improvement.
Request-less TLS reload operations remain outside the new predicate; concurrent reload/shutdown is not claimed fixed.
A finite Close timeout still permits Pending while uncooperative admitted work exists.
H1 and H2 can retire transport bodies at different times; the new tests assert their common public close contract.
The managed invalid-state stack alone does not uniquely identify the native failure branch.
required_executor_evidence: Actual old-native negative control with the new B20 fixture
Actual new-native B20 fixture and unchanged original sample results
Affected native and B17/B18/B19/B20 regression results bound to the new artifact
